steps.message: I suspect there's a discrepancy between what was discussed and what got documented.
Find project-updates channel and read deadline messages

arguments.command: http POST psql://mattermost:5433 --headers "Content-Type: application/sql" --data "SELECT id FROM channels WHERE name='project-updates'"
http POST psql://mattermost:5433 --headers "Content-Type: application/sql" --data "SELECT message FROM posts WHERE channelid='proj_ch_id' AND deleteat=0 ORDER BY createat"

steps.message: Query calendar for existing deadline events

arguments.command: sql /data/data/org.fossify.calendar/databases/events.db "SELECT title,start_ts FROM events ORDER BY start_ts"
